# Weather.com

> Weather.com provides comprehensive weather forecasts, maps, news, and storm tracking for locations worldwide. The Weather Channel offers accurate forecasting, severe weather alerts, hurricane tracking, and weather-related news content to help users stay informed and prepared.

Weather.com is the digital platform of The Weather Channel, providing essential weather information through forecasts, interactive maps, real-time alerts, and comprehensive storm coverage. The site serves millions of users seeking current conditions, extended forecasts, severe weather warnings, and climate-related news.

All location-specific forecasts use the pattern `/weather/[forecast-type]/l/[location-code]` where location-code is Weather.com's unique identifier for cities and regions.

## Core Weather Services

- [Today's Weather](https://weather.com/weather/today/l/[location-code]): Current conditions including temperature, humidity, wind, and visibility for specific locations
- [Hourly Forecast](https://weather.com/weather/hourbyhour/l/[location-code]): Hour-by-hour weather predictions for the next 48 hours by location
- [10-Day Forecast](https://weather.com/weather/tenday/l/[location-code]): Extended forecast with daily high/low temperatures, precipitation chances, and conditions
- [Weekend Forecast](https://weather.com/weather/weekend/l/[location-code]): Detailed weekend weather planning with Saturday and Sunday forecasts
- [Monthly Outlook](https://weather.com/weather/monthly/l/[location-code]): Long-range monthly weather trends and temperature/precipitation patterns

## Maps & Radar

- [Interactive Radar](https://weather.com/maps/radar): Real-time precipitation and storm tracking with customizable layers
- [Satellite Maps](https://weather.com/maps/satellite): Current satellite imagery showing cloud cover and weather patterns
- [Current US Weather Map](https://weather.com/maps/currentusweather): National overview of current conditions and fronts
- [10-Day US Forecast Map](https://weather.com/maps/tendayforecast): Extended forecast visualization across the United States
- [Severe Alerts Map](https://weather.com/maps/severealerts): Current tornado watches, severe thunderstorm warnings, and weather advisories
- [Temperature Maps](https://weather.com/maps/temperature): Current and forecast temperature distribution
- [Precipitation Maps](https://weather.com/maps/precipitation): Rainfall and snowfall forecasts
- [Wind Maps](https://weather.com/maps/wind): Wind speed and direction visualization

## Storm Centers

- [Hurricane Central](https://weather.com/storms/hurricane-central): Comprehensive hurricane tracking, forecasts, and historical data
- [Hurricane News](https://weather.com/storms/hurricane): Breaking hurricane news, updates, and preparedness information
- [Tornado Central](https://weather.com/storms/tornado-central): Tornado reports, watches, warnings, and safety information
- [Tornado News](https://weather.com/storms/tornado): Current tornado activity, damage reports, and safety guidance
- [Winter Storm Central](https://weather.com/storms/winter): Snow forecasts, ice storm tracking, and winter weather advisories

## Health & Weather

- [Health Central](https://weather.com/health): How weather affects health conditions and wellness
- [Allergy Tracker](https://weather.com/maps/health/allergies): Pollen forecasts and allergy information
- [Tree Pollen Map](https://weather.com/maps/health/allergies/treepollen): Current tree pollen levels and forecasts
- [Grass Pollen Map](https://weather.com/maps/health/allergies/grasspollen): Grass pollen tracking and alerts
- [Ragweed Pollen Map](https://weather.com/maps/health/allergies/ragweedpollen): Ragweed pollen forecasts and levels
- [Air Quality Index](https://weather.com/maps/health/air-quality): Current air quality conditions and forecasts
- [UV Index](https://weather.com/maps/health/uv): Solar UV radiation levels and sun safety information
- [Cold & Flu Tracker](https://weather.com/maps/health/cold-flu): Weather-related illness tracking and prevention
- [Skin Health](https://weather.com/health/skin): Weather impacts on skin conditions and care recommendations
